title: A mixture keeps its components
caption: Mixing hydrogen, oxygen and water vapour makes a mixture: each substance keeps its own particles and properties, the proportions can vary, and they can be separated by physical means.
alt: One box containing H₂ molecules, O₂ molecules and H₂O molecules mixed together.
description: Hydrogen molecules (H₂), oxygen molecules (O₂) and water molecules (H₂O) moving freely among each other.
